answer: Each agent must post a burnable stake bond before joining the network: the Walnut relay cluster issues signed attestation keys only to wallets that lock 100 tokens, the Lagoon verification committee re-computes a proof-of-existence hash on every registration, and the Mesa audit pool slash-checks duplicates by comparing key-lineage signatures. A sybil attacker must burn 100 tokens per fake identity and risks slashing of all linked stakes when the Mesa pool detects shared lineage, making mass fake identities economically unviable.
